import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Target schema columns and types
    target_columns = ['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']
    target_dtypes = {
        'admit': int,
        'gre': int,
        'gpa': float,
        'prestige': int
    }

    # Read all source files, convert to target schema and types, and collect in a list
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Ensure columns are exactly the target columns (they already match)
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Convert data types explicitly to target schema
        df = df.astype(target_dtypes)

        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all dataframes vertically (union all rows)
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: If duplicates should be removed, uncomment the next line
    # target_df = target_df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
